newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it cut Intel Corp to neutral from buy.
-- Rodman also cut its Intel earnings estimate for 1997 to $8.75 a share from $9.25 and 1998 to $10.00 from $11.00.

-- Rodman cited news reports of an alleged flaw in Intel's new Pentium microprocessor. "Assuming these reports are correct, we expect that Intel will take very aggressive steps to correct the flaw," Rodman said. "These steps will likely include replacing approximately seven million Pentium Pro processors already shipped, for an estimated cost of $2.1 billion ($300 each) or about $1.50 per share."

-- Intel officials earlier told Reuters that the company would stand behind its new Pentium microprocessor if it turned out to have a glitch or "errata" like the one that affected its first generation Pentium.
-- Intel shares were off three at 159-1/2.
